verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Grok Build agentic coding is available "on the API and CLI," and a hands-on community report calls Grok Build "a very good CLI." An official CLI exists, but the evidence is a single brief docs mention with no CLI-specific documentation. missing for 10: CLI installation and setup docs, command reference, authentication/configuration details, scripting/non-interactive usage for AI-native workflows, and in-depth first-party CLI documentation beyond a one-line overview mention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Agentic coding with Grok Build (grok-4.7), our coding model, on the API and CLI.
I've been using Grok Build over the last couple weeks. It's actually a very good CLI.
